entities.summary: Peter Hoyt Dominick was an American diplomat, politician and lawyer from Colorado. A member of the Republican Party, he served in the United States Senate from 1963 to 1975. His uncle, Howard Alexander Smith, was a U.S. senator from New Jersey from 1944 to 1959.
